description: This Java class 'IoUtil' provides utility functions for communication with an engine control system, including sending commands, waiting for responses, changing RPM, launching a simulator, and establishing hardware connections. It interacts with other components like CommandQueue, LinkManager, SensorCentral, and logging utilities.

classes.name: IoUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing engine control commands, sensor updates, simulator launching, and hardware connections in a Java-based engine management system.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string to the engine and waits for confirmation with default or specified timeouts.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a CountDownLatch to count down within a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: changeRpm
methods.description: Changes the engine RPM to a specified value and waits until the sensor reflects the change, then resets the engine chart.

methods.name: waitForFirstResponse
methods.description: Waits for the first sensor response indicating the engine has started.

methods.name: launchSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process and establishes a TCP connection for testing purposes.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a given number of seconds.

methods.name: realHardwareConnect
methods.description: Connects to real hardware via a specified serial port.
